name: t6
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II (T6)
note: BO2 (T6), 32-bit: the Steam t6mp.exe with SteamStub removed by Steamless (.text entropy 6.70), flattened (file offset == RVA). Load_Stream, push and pop are real cdecl functions (1 322, 115 and 44 calls); Load_Stream dispatches on the block through a jump table.
rva_note: read off t6mp.exe: Load_Stream 0x19b6a0 (flag, dst, size) jumps on the block index (table 0x59b764): 0, 5, 6 read through DB_LoadXFileData 0x180f50 (dst, size), 1, 2 memset, 3, 4 recorded for after the assets (0x19b790), 7 returns without advancing; then DB_IncStreamPos 0x19b660; DB_ReadXFileString 0x181060 (dst) hooked as file_string; Load_XStringCustom 0x19b820 (char**); push 0x19b570 (block), pop 0x19b5e0 (a pop into block 0 rewinds it); DB_AllocStreamPos 0x19b640 (alignment - 1); DB_InitStreams 0x19b500 (the XBlock table, 8 bytes per block); DB_InsertPointer 0x19b670 pushes 5, aligns 4, takes 4, pops; DB_ConvertOffsetToPointer 0x19b800 and DB_ConvertOffsetToAlias 0x19b7d0: block = (v - 1) >> 29

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAssetHeader: compares varXAsset->type and tail-jumps to the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set to varXAssetHeader (Load_XAsset 0x195a00 reads the entry, sets varXAssetHeader = varXAsset + 4, jumps here)

stream.block_span_note: 432 MB per block from 0x21000000: block 5 passes 256 MB in the biggest zones (angola: 272 MB after a 168 MB loaded sound bank)
stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording: blocks 5 (virtual, 5 929 484 reads) and 6 (physical, 53 554) only grow over all 297 zones; block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (302 241 of 303 276 reads below its previous end); 3 and 4 (delayed) receive nothing

release.note: emuwalk 297/297 zones identical read for read; measure (zones up to 256 MB) 274/274; check --jobs 4 over every zone 628 116/628 116 occurrences exact (the sampled count depends on --jobs and the banding)
